Enjoy Unbeatable Drink Specials with a Wide Selection of Crafted Cocktails

When you’re in Las Vegas, a trip to Herbs and Rye is essential. Known for its incredible happy hour deals, perfectly cooked steaks, and historic cocktails, Herbs and Rye is a place you don’t want to miss. Whether you’re a local or visiting, the Las Vegas Strip offers no better happy hour experience.

What to Expect from Happy Hour at Herbs and Rye

Happy hour at Herbs and Rye is available every day, with amazing drink specials and menu items at discounted prices. Here’s a breakdown of their happy hour specials, which run from 5 PM to 8 PM, and again from 12 AM to 3 AM, making it a popular late-night spot for locals and tourists alike.

Herbs and Rye is known for its expertly crafted cocktail menu, which blends classic concoctions with modern twists. From vintage cocktails to signature creations, there’s something for every palate. Here are some highly recommended specialty drinks that pair perfectly with a steak dinner:

Why Make a Reservation?

With its popular happy hour deals and amazing menu items, Herbs and Rye is a sought-after restaurant on the Las Vegas Strip. To ensure you get a seat, it’s always recommended to make reservations in advance, especially if you’re planning to go during peak times or late-night happy hours. You can easily make reservations through their website or by calling directly.

Happy Hour Menu Items You Can’t Miss

The happy hour menu at Herbs and Rye is filled with decadent appetizers, expertly cooked steaks, and delicious pasta dishes. Here are some menu items that are must-tries:

Menu Item Description Happy Hour Price Regular Price
Ribeye Steak (14oz) Cooked to perfection, this ribeye is seasoned with herbs and grilled to your preferred doneness. Served with garlic mashed potatoes or pasta. $25 $50
Filet Mignon (8oz) A tender cut, customer favorite, served with mac and cheese or a light herb butter sauce. $24 $48
Pasta with Garlic and Shrimp A delicate pasta dish tossed with a rich garlic cream sauce and fresh seafood. $15 $30

These dishes are expertly prepared and offer a great value during happy hour. Don’t forget to pair them with one of the signature cocktails for the full Herbs and Rye experience!

Visit Herbs and Rye for the Best Steak in Las Vegas

For those seeking the best steak in Las Vegas, Herbs and Rye has earned a stellar reputation. Whether you prefer a succulent filet mignon or a flavorful ribeye, the steak here is cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor.

What to Know About the Vibe

The atmosphere at Herbs and Rye is reminiscent of an old-world speakeasy with dark wood accents, dim lighting, and an intimate ambiance. Whether you’re enjoying the cocktail list or savoring a perfectly cooked steak, the vibe adds to the overall experience. Customers often highly recommend the cozy yet lively feel of the restaurant, making it a great spot for a happy hour with friends or a date night.

Make a Reservation and Plan Your Visit

The popularity of Herbs and Rye can make it difficult to secure a table during happy hour without prior reservations. Here’s how you can ensure you don’t miss out on this incredible dining experience:

To avoid long wait times, it’s highly recommended to book a reservation ahead of time, especially if you’re planning to visit during peak happy hour periods. Whether you’re celebrating with friends or just enjoying a night out in Las Vegas, Herbs and Rye promises a memorable experience!

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What are the happy hour times at Herbs and Rye?

Happy hour is available daily from 5 PM to 8 PM and late night from 12 AM to 3 AM.

Is Herbs and Rye located on the Las Vegas Strip?

No, Herbs and Rye is located just off the Las Vegas Strip, offering a more intimate dining experience away from the hustle and bustle of the main strip.

Do I need to make reservations?

It is highly recommended to make reservations ahead of time, especially for happy hour, as the restaurant can get very busy during peak times.

What’s the best steak on the menu?

The ribeye and filet mignon are the most popular choices. Both are cooked to perfection and seasoned with herbs for maximum flavor.

What are the best cocktails at Herbs and Rye?

Some of the best cocktails include the Old Fashioned, Manhattan, and the Rye Manhattan. All of these are available at discounted prices during happy hour.

Is there a dress code?

The dress code is casual, but since this is a steakhouse with a speakeasy vibe, many guests choose to dress smart-casual for a more refined dining experience.

Explore the Boiling Crab Menu to discover top seafood picks and flavorful Cajun dishes here.

With this guide, you now have everything you need to know about enjoying the happy hour at Herbs and Rye in Las Vegas. Whether you’re in the mood for a perfectly grilled steak, a classic cocktail, or just looking for a great happy hour deal, Herbs and Rye will not disappoint. So make your reservation, grab your friends, and get ready for a memorable dining experience in the heart of Las Vegas.
